description:
[Calculators] Fall damage from a height or a landing speed. Damage = 500 x InverseLerp(15, 100, landing speed m/s), before clothing protection (BasePlayer.
ApplyFallDamageFromVelocity), plus bleeding 0.5 x the same fraction. Returns `damage`, `bleeding`, `speed_ms`,
`height_m`, `safe_height_m` (no damage below), `lethal_height_m` (100 damage), `gravity_ms2` and
`height_is_estimate`. Speed -> damage is exact; heights assume no air resistance. Speed to damage is exact; heights for awake players are an estimate (client-side movement). Link https://rust.wiki/survival-mechanics#fall.

player.description: awake (gravity estimated - awake movement runs on the client) or sleeping (the server's own fall for sleeping/wounded players, from the code).

name: calculate_fall_damage
title: Fall damage from a height or a landing speed
